schema_policy.justification: All three selected structures are fixed-geometry with explicit per-position entries (distillation_tower 81, large_boiler 36, tank_3x3x3 26); the largest (81) is below the 125-position aisle/repeat trigger line and MAX_SCAN_VOLUME 4,096 leaves 35x headroom. No selected geometry needs aisle/repeat, dynamic ports or environment anchors; unknown predicate/port roles fail closed via the codec (MultiblockStructureDefinition), enforced by mutation tests.
schema_policy.old_structures_untouched: coke_oven.json and large_centrifuge.json remain schema_version 1 and load unchanged; full-rotation and pinned-shape tests re-verified (T23 B1).
schema_policy.preview: Loader, validator and runtime share one codec semantics; rendering preview is not implemented (phase-4 master plan T23 out-of-scope).
